title: Tech Note: Reusable SVG — The Power of <defs>
author: Charles “Charlie” Vass, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D SVG area (SVG_New_rect, SVG_New_line, SVG_Use, SVG_New_symbol commands)
SVG patterns, style sheets, and symbol reuse

historical_commentary.text: 4D's SVG area and its SVG_* command set (including SVG_New_rect, SVG_Use, and pattern/definition support) are still present in current 4D and the underlying SVG <defs>/reuse technique described here remains valid, so this note is still directly usable as a reference for building efficient SVG graphics in 4D forms. It predates 4D's later investment in richer built-in charting/data-visualization tools and picture-variable based UI approaches, which now offer alternative, lower-code ways to achieve similar visual results for many common cases.
